mentions.name: Disposable Apps
mentions.description: A soft-launched platform for micro-tools, described as 'Hugging face for micro-tools'. Each week a few apps are proposed, community voting decides which ones stay (the rest get disposed of), and the surviving apps are available for a flat monthly subscription.
mentions.source_excerpt: Just soft launched: http://disposableapps.com - Hugging face for micro-tools. Disposable apps propose few apps a week and the ones with max votes stay and rest gets "disposed off" and the ones which stay are available for flat monthly subscription.
